m.nama.n1: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, Satya Sāī Bābā.
m.nama.n2: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose very form is truth.
m.nama.n3: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is devoted to truth and dharma.
m.nama.n4: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of boons.
m.nama.n5: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the good and true Person.
m.nama.n6: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose nature is the virtue of truth.
m.nama.n7: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who makes the good flourish.
m.nama.n8: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who sustains the good.
m.nama.n9: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the knower of all.
m.nama.n10: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is dear to all people.
m.nama.n11: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the embodiment of all power.
m.nama.n12: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the lord of all.
m.nama.n13: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who has renounced all attachment.
m.nama.n14: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the inner ruler of all.
m.nama.n15: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose very nature is greatness.
m.nama.n16: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is Maheśvara (Śiva) in form.
m.nama.n17: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who was born in the village of Parti.
m.nama.n18: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who dwells in the holy place of Parti.
m.nama.n19: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who dwelt at Śirḍī in a body of glory.
m.nama.n20: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, Somappa (Śiva with Umā) of Joḍi Ādipalli.
m.nama.n21: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, born in the gotra of the sage Bharadvāja.
m.nama.n22: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is loving to his devotees.
m.nama.n23: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the indwelling Self of all.
m.nama.n24: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the embodiment of the avatāra.
m.nama.n25: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the remover of all fears.
m.nama.n26: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, born in a family of the Āpastamba sūtra.
m.nama.n27: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of fearlessness.
m.nama.n28: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who was born in the Ratnākara family.
m.nama.n29: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the incarnation of power who is one with Śirḍī Sāī.
m.nama.n30: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, Śaṅkara (Śiva), the giver of good.
m.nama.n31: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the embodiment of Śirḍī Sāī.
m.nama.n32: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who dwelt in Dvārakāmāī, the mosque at Śirḍī.
m.nama.n33: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who sports at Puttaparthi on the bank of the Citrāvatī.
m.nama.n34: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of strength.
m.nama.n35: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the protector of those who come for refuge.
m.nama.n36: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is bliss.
m.nama.n37: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of bliss.
m.nama.n38: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is intent on saving the afflicted.
m.nama.n39: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the protector of the forlorn.
m.nama.n40: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the helper of the helpless.
m.nama.n41: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the kinsman of the world.
m.nama.n42: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is intent on protecting the world.
m.nama.n43: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the lord of the worlds.
m.nama.n44: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who sustains the needy.
m.nama.n45: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose form is the three forms of Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Śiva.
m.nama.n46: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of liberation.
m.nama.n47: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is far removed from impurity.
m.nama.n48: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the treasury of compassion.
m.nama.n49: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the support of all.
m.nama.n50: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who dwells in every heart.
m.nama.n51: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of the fruit of merit.
m.nama.n52: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the destroyer of all sins.
m.nama.n53: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the remover of all illness.
m.nama.n54: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the remover of all obstacles.
m.nama.n55: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the Maker, praised without end.
m.nama.n56: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the primal Person.
m.nama.n57: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the primal power.
m.nama.n58: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose power is beyond compare.
m.nama.n59: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose form is unmanifest.
m.nama.n60: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the destroyer of desire and anger.
m.nama.n61: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who wears golden garments.
m.nama.n62: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose ways are wondrous.
m.nama.n63: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the kinsman in times of distress.
m.nama.n64: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose very self is love.
m.nama.n65: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the embodiment of love.
m.nama.n66: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of love.
m.nama.n67: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the beloved.
m.nama.n68: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is dear to his devotees.
m.nama.n69: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the mandāra (the tree of paradise) for his devotees.
m.nama.n70: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who sports in the hearts of his devotees.
m.nama.n71: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose abode is the hearts of his devotees.
m.nama.n72: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is bound to his devotees.
m.nama.n73: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the lamp of devotion and knowledge.
m.nama.n74: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of devotion and knowledge.
m.nama.n75: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who shows the path of true knowledge.
m.nama.n76: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is knowledge itself.
m.nama.n77: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the teacher of the Gītā.
m.nama.n78: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of the attainment of knowledge.
m.nama.n79: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose form is beautiful.
m.nama.n80: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the holy Person.
m.nama.n81: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of the fruit of action.
m.nama.n82: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the supreme Person.
m.nama.n83: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the ancient Person.
m.nama.n84: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is beyond all.
m.nama.n85: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is beyond time.
m.nama.n86: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is perfection itself.
m.nama.n87: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose every resolve comes true.
m.nama.n88: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of health.
m.nama.n89: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of food and clothing.
m.nama.n90: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the destroyer of the sorrows of worldly existence.
m.nama.n91: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of all that is desired.
m.nama.n92: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, whose qualities are auspicious.
m.nama.n93: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the destroyer of karma.
m.nama.n94: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who shines in the minds of the good.
m.nama.n95: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is honoured by all faiths.
m.nama.n96: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the purifier of the minds of the good.
m.nama.n97: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who planted the banyan tree as a grace for seekers.
m.nama.n98: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the remover of every doubt.
m.nama.n99: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who makes all truths known.
m.nama.n100: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the lord of yogīs.
m.nama.n101: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is worshipped by the greatest of yogīs.
m.nama.n102: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who brings all that is auspicious.
m.nama.n103: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the giver of every attainment.
m.nama.n104: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the remover of misfortune.
m.nama.n105: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the remover of suffering.
m.nama.n106: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the embodiment of peace.
m.nama.n107: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, who is easily pleased.
m.nama.n108: Om, salutations to Śrī Sāī, the Lord (Bhagavān) Satya Sāī Bābā.
m.iti: Thus ends the garland of a hundred and eight names (Aṣṭottara Śatanāmāvalī) of Śrī Satya Sāī.
